home.subtitle: Sahayak eliminates bureaucratic friction with high-performance Rust eligibility matching, sovereign DigiLocker verification, and autonomous Chrome extension form auto-fill.
home.pillarsSubtitle: A complete end-to-end bridge between ordinary Indian citizens and government welfare schemes.
home.feature1Desc: Our Chrome MV3 extension bridges your verified DigiLocker vault directly to official portals (PM-KISAN, NSP, SSY) with zero manual typing.
home.feature2Desc: Inspect simulated sovereign Aadhaar e-KYC, Tehsildar income records, and caste certificates. Edit attributes in real time to test matching.
home.feature3Desc: Bhashini-powered conversational AI understands Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and English via voice or text with contextual government guidance.
home.feature4Desc: Real-time officer dashboard for short-polling and approving citizen welfare applications with full audit trails on Render PostgreSQL.
